decisions.reason: As a multi-model formwork line close to the core offer, it likely remains near aspiration levels and supports broader system sales, so management would usually retain it.

This automation control product fits the firm's strategy of integrated factory systems, and despite weaker standalone visibility its strategic relatedness makes continuation more likely than withdrawal.
Shuttering magnet blocks complement the established formwork portfolio and can use existing channels and capabilities, so the firm would tend to keep them unless performance clearly disappoints.
Magnetic formwork strips are strongly aligned with the firm's modular formwork business and likely remain valuable in bundled and customer-specific solutions, favoring retention.
This magnetic formwork component is narrower than the main lines but still uses familiar technology and sales relationships, so available slack and relatedness support keeping it on the market.

Because it had the weakest initial prominence and appears most overlapping with other magnetic formwork items, management would be more likely to reallocate its resources if results stayed below aspiration.
